# Known failures of the Java SDK suite against a Floci deployed in eusc-de-east-1, with the
# fixture clients signing for eusc-de-east-1 (.github/workflows/compat-partitions.yml).
# Checked by .github/ci/compat-allowlist-check.py: one `Class#method` per line; a failure
# missing from this list, or an entry that no longer fails, fails the run. Delete an entry
# as soon as its test passes. Measured 2026-10-13 on main 367ae0b2d, JVM image; failures
# that also occur in the commercial control run are environmental and not listed.

# The Resource Groups model cannot name an EUSC resource: GroupStringV2 and ResourceArn both
# require the region to be `[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d`, which `eusc-de-east-1` never matches, so
# GroupResources rejects the capacity reservation's own ARN. Floci enforces the model as published.
